land.text: Seville, taken by Athanagild against Agila

predecessors.note: The Athanagild page names no province; the Spania page has him 'took Seville'.

land.text: Seville, taken by Athanagild against Agila

successors.note: Athanagild is sole ruler after Agila's death (554 on the Athanagild page, March 555 on the Spania page); the rebel land is the kingdom's again.

capitals.name: Seville (Hispalis)
capitals.note: 'The armies of Agila and Athanagild met at Seville' (Athanagild page); 'Athanagild took Seville' (Spania page).

rulers.name: Athanagild
rulers.title: rebel king
rulers.note: Rebel from 551; the infobox gives his reign from March 554.

correction.text: Seville, taken by Athanagild against Agila

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: the rebel holds Seville against Agila, who 'was pushed back to Mérida' (Spania page). The pages name only the city, so the shape is a 100 km disc around it; Cliopatria has no row for the rebels.

region.text: Seville, taken by Athanagild against Agila

ledger.note: 551: Athanagild rebels against King Agila and takes Seville. 'He had rebelled against his predecessor, Agila I, in 551' (Athanagild page); the Spania page: 'a nobleman named Athanagild took Seville', 'Either at the commencement of his reign (549) or as late as 551'.

region.text: Seville, taken by Athanagild against Agila

ledger.note: 554: Agila dies and Athanagild reigns alone. 'Following the death of Agila in 554, he was sole ruler for the rest of his reign' (Athanagild page; the Spania page puts Agila's murder in late March 555).

wars.name: Visigothic civil war of Agila and Athanagild

zones.text: Seville, taken by Athanagild against Agila

wars.outcome: Athanagild takes Seville, wins with Byzantine help and becomes sole king; the Byzantines keep a province on the south coast.
wars.note: The Spania page dates the rebellion 549-551 and the Byzantine victory over Agila to August or September 552.

certainty.note: The pages name only Seville; the extent of the rebel land is not given.

sources.title: Athanagild
sources.note: Revolt of 551, battle at Seville, Agila's death 554, reign from March 554.

sources.title: Spania
sources.note: Seville, the appeal to Justinian, the 552 landing, Agila's murder 555.

notes: A rebel state with a year-for-year record only for Seville. The Byzantine intervention (Athanagild asked Justinian for help; the force landed in June or July 552 and with him defeated Agila in August or September 552, Spania page) is in the war entry and the Visigothic Kingdom ledger (555), not here. The two pages disagree on the start (549-551) and end (554 or March 555). No Cliopatria row. A gap-filler should open Agila I for the extent of the rebel land.
